csv_project_name: Engineering for Cabot North Tributary Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Cabot North Tributary Bridge Replacement Project: Preliminary and Final Engineering Design, Permitting, and Construction Bid Services. The Town selected two flood mitigation alternatives to reduce local flood levels and debris clogging replacing the North Tributary bridge with a larger elevated structure and replacing the twin culvert on the South Tributary with a bridge across Main Street. Conceptual engineering design and cost estimates were completed for these using a FEMA grant.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Engineering for Cabot North Tributary Bridge Replacement
short_description: Design services for replacing two flood-prone crossings in Cabot, Vermont.
project_scope: Replacement of the North Tributary bridge with a larger elevated structure and replacement of the twin culvert on the South Tributary with a bridge across Main Street. The project aims to reduce local flood levels and debris clogging. Conceptual engineering design and cost estimates have already been completed under a FEMA grant.
services: Preliminary and final engineering design, permitting, and construction bid services; disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge replacement project with clear structural engineering scope.
- Includes preliminary and final design, permitting, and bid-phase services, offering meaningful planning involvement.
- Flood-resilient replacement crossings may require hydraulic and structural coordination.
- Road bridge infrastructure is relevant to sbp, though no major span or architecturally exceptional structure is described.
- Moderate construction budget suggests limited structural complexity compared with landmark bridge projects.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Available fee-related basis: total construction cost is 3.4 million USD and services include preliminary and final engineering design, permitting, and construction bid services for two crossing replacements.
references_qualifications: Bidders are sought for civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Town of Cabot, Cabot, Vermont, USA. Email: tc@cabotvt.us. Phone: 802-563-2279. Website: https://cabotvt.us/flood-resiliency-task-force/. Question contact: gary.gulka@gmail.com.
notes: Project concerns two separate flood mitigation crossing replacements: North Tributary bridge replacement and South Tributary culvert replacement with a bridge on Main Street. Solicitation documents are available online. Questions deadline: 05/27/2026 04:00 PM EDT.
